verdict.rationale: Mastra is a TypeScript framework for building agents, and its Studio and Cloud could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only developer building blocks (agents, memory, workflows) for constructing such a feature, plus observability and eval dashboards (traces, latency, cost, scoring) that are not AI-generated insights or suggestions. No first-party, in-product capability for AI insights on the user's data is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
